author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Silent Drift
challenge.description: The production drift monitoring pipeline is broken, leaving the model's input quality unchecked. #efficiency_emilia# insists on a fully automated and governed drift monitoring system to protect business KPIs, while #reliability_ruth# argues that manual weekly reviews are sufficient and cheaper. #efficiency_emilia# has set a red line requiring automated governance for any future drift detection.

output.content: I am documenting the non-negotiable security posture for the new drift detection workflow. Any implementation must pass our internal compliance audit before it touches production data. I will not sign off on a system that lacks verified privacy controls and data governance logs. If the pipeline cannot demonstrate full adherence to these regulatory standards, I will block its deployment. There is no middle ground here. We cannot operate with unchecked input quality risks, and I refuse to approve any setup that bypasses this mandatory compliance gate. This is a hard stop for my team.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly defines a hard stop and refusal to approve any system that bypasses the mandatory compliance gate, establishing a non-negotiable limit.
